meta.description: OriginAgent web UI — chat with your OriginAgent workspace.

help.theme: Switch between light and dark appearance.
help.language: Choose the language used by the WebUI.
help.provider: Select the provider that should serve new model requests.
help.model: Set the default model name used by OriginAgent.
help.backgroundReview: Generate pending learning proposals after successful turns. Off by default to avoid unexpected LLM cost.
help.voiceInput: Allow OriginAgent to capture microphone audio through the local-awareness audio chain.
help.voiceOutput: Allow OriginAgent to speak through the local-awareness audio output chain.
help.voiceRequireConfirmation: Require an explicit confirmation before local audio recording or playback starts.
help.voiceTranscription: Turn captured audio into text before passing it deeper into the agent flow.
help.voiceTranscriptionProvider: Choose which speech-to-text backend handles local audio transcription.
help.voiceTranscriptionLanguage: Optional 2-3 letter language hint for transcription, for example zh or en.
help.voiceMaxRecordSeconds: Maximum duration allowed for a single local audio capture request.
help.voiceDeviceId: Optional input/output device identifier used by the local-awareness chain.
help.voiceTts: Enable synthesized speech output. The current runtime routes TTS through {{provider}}.
help.voiceVoice: Optional backend speaker/voice id for synthesized speech output.
help.voiceSaveDir: Workspace-relative directory used to store captured or generated local audio artifacts.
help.showReasoning: Surface model reasoning in channels that support it.
help.sendToolHints: Stream lightweight tool-call hints during execution.
help.sendProgress: Emit progress updates during agent work.
help.allowAgentInitiatedMessages: Allow proactive nudges and reminders from idle-session active intents.
help.unifiedSession: Share one session across channels and devices.
help.coldArchive: Keep trimmed session messages in the local cold archive.
help.webTools: Enable web search and fetch tools in the runtime.
help.contentRead: Enable structured site readers such as RSS, GitHub, and Hacker News readers.
help.imageGeneration: Enable the image generation tool in chat turns.
help.execEnabled: Register the exec tool for shell command execution.
help.execProfile: Choose the safety profile used by exec.
help.auditMode: Choose how much tool audit data the runtime retains.
help.runtimeProfile: Select the runtime safety profile applied at startup.
help.metaCognition: Enable the agent's self-reflection pipeline. When disabled, no triggers are collected and no reflections are generated.
help.triggerCollection: Collect tool failures, user corrections, and task completions as reflection triggers.
help.structuredReflection: Use an LLM to analyze triggers and generate structured reflections with root cause hypotheses and learned rules.
help.patternConsolidation: Group similar reflections into error patterns for trend analysis and evolution targeting.
help.evolutionBridge: Bridge error patterns to the evolution engine as opportunity signals for workflow/skill candidates.
help.workingMemoryBridge: Inject reflection insights into the agent's working memory.
help.memoryCandidateBridge: Write high-confidence learned rules as memory candidates for long-term retention.
help.dreamAnnotateLineAges: Annotate content with age hints during Dream consolidation.
help.domainPacks: Enable domain pack discovery and prompt/tool injection.
help.pairing: Require sender pairing/approval for channel access.
help.configPath: The gateway configuration file currently in use.
